Keep the display-settings toggle's aria-expanded in sync on toggle and outside-click close.

modified.src/env.d.ts: Declare the adapter-provided Expressive Code runtime virtual module used by Layout and Markdown.
modified.src/components/organisms/PostCard.astro: Retain 640x360 layout dimensions for pass-through Site covers, with metadata dimensions overriding when available.
modified.src/components/organisms/BannerStage.ast: Give banner placeholders intrinsic layout dimensions; disabled banner still has no Site asset request.
modified.src/utils/url-utils.ts: Preserve existing ALNILAM language-prefixed post URLs, /categories/<category>/, /tags/<tag>/ and plural /archives/ paths.

modified.src/pages/archive.astro: Add native PageHeader for one semantic page h1; serialize only fields used by ArchivePanel to reduce archive HTML size.
modified.src/components/molecules/ImageWrapper.as: Preserve explicit 640x360 layout dimensions for public/remote Site covers.
modified.src/utils/setting-utils.ts: Default to Site appearance when no stored visitor choice; keep native theme state and controls.

modified.src/components/atoms/blog/PagePagination: Preserve rel=prev/next pagination semantics on both native desktop/mobile controls and consolidate jump handler into Layout runtime script.
modified.src/components/molecules/WidgetLayout.as: Consolidate widget-layout custom element registration into Layout runtime script.
modified.src/components/molecules/SearchBar.svelt: Semantic keyboard search trigger, Escape/focus restoration, cancel focus/blur timers on unmount.
modified.src/components/atoms/blog/SearchPanel.sv: Render an explicit no-results state with the localized message and a status role, driven by the caller so an empty result set reads as an answer instead of an empty box.
modified.src/components/organisms/Search.svelte: Preserve request ordering, Escape/focus restoration and remove listeners on unmount using native Search/Panel. Resolve search strings from the current page locale (documentElement.lang, kept in sync on Swup views). Track the panel open state (class observer covers outside-click closing) and expose aria-expanded/aria-controls on the toggle. Keep the results panel open after a finished search and pass the localized no-results state, so an empty result set is an answer instead of a silently closed panel. The empty state follows the query of the visible input (desktop capsule above 1024px, panel input below it), so a layout switch cannot show a no-results message next to an empty input.
modified.src/components/organisms/Footer.astro: Link to existing Core rss.xml/sitemap.xml; omit unimplemented Atom route.
modified.src/components/organisms/Profile.astro: Use configured Site name for avatar fallback; disabled About module links home.
modified.src/components/organisms/CategoryBar.ast: ALNILAM addition: hide the category bar on category/tag detail routes using the base-stripped root-relative path; the upstream startsWith('/categories') check never matched under a nested base such as /ALNILAM/ (#124).
modified.src/config/integrationsConfig.ts: Use installed Vite8 native Oxc/LightningCSS minifiers instead of forcing its optional esbuild peer in the target toolchain; minification remains enabled.

modified.src/plugins/rehype-safe-markdown-links.m: Remove unsafe URL schemes from Markdown links while retaining link text.
modified.src/plugins/rehype-markdown-images.mjs: Resolve relative and Site-asset Markdown images into managed _astro / subpath URLs, retain query and fragment, and guarantee explicit width/height dimensions.
modified.src/utils/nav-utils.ts: Map ALNILAM /posts, /archives, /tags, and /bangumi routes in resolvePageKey for native active-link highlighting.
modified.src/components/molecules/FloatingActionB: Render static FAB button shell without redundant per-button client:load island hydration.
modified.src/components/organisms/TopAppBar.astro: Gate DisplaySettings island on !siteConfig.themeColor.fixed and consolidate TopAppBar navigation runtime into Layout. Add server-rendered aria-expanded/aria-controls to the menu button so the drawer disclosure is announced before hydration. Add aria-expanded/aria-controls to the display-settings toggle. Add the stable #main-navigation id so browser contracts select the navigation landmark without depending on its accessible name. Localize the navigation landmark name with the page language.
modified.src/layouts/MainGridLayout.astro: Gate BannerStage when banner images and homeText are disabled; render RouteProgress without redundant island hydration; move the sidebar elements after the main content column so mobile DOM/parse order matches the visual order (content → sidebar → footer) and the already-painted aside is no longer pushed down by late-parsed article blocks (real mobile CLS); desktop columns stay on explicit lg:/xl: col-start/row-start.
modified.src/components/organisms/SideBar.astro: Render only widgets visible on the current page in static MPA mode and omit unused Swup polling script.
modified.src/components/organisms/FloatingControl: Render TOC floating panel/button only on pages where TOC is visible and consolidate FAB init into Layout.
modified.src/components/organisms/PostPage.astro: Consolidate post-list masonry initialization into Layout runtime script.
modified.src/components/organisms/SiteNavigationD: Sync aria-expanded on #nav-drawer-switch, replay a drawer tap recorded before the island mounted, trap Tab focus inside the aria-modal panel while open, dismiss on outside press or Escape with focus restored, and close mobile drawer on desktop viewport resize. Focus the first drawer item only once the open class makes the panel visible. Expose aria-expanded only after the panel is visible and focused, and keep Tab inside while the opening frame precedes computed visibility. Mark non-drawer body children inert while the modal is open (restored on close, resize and unmount). Localize the drawer navigation landmark name with the page language.

modified.src/components/molecules/SidebarTOC.astr: Respect prefers-reduced-motion when scrolling to TOC anchors.
